description: Defines data structures, constants, and methods for content flagging notification settings, reviewer settings, and related configurations in the Mattermost project.

classes.name: ContentFlaggingNotificationSettings
classes.description: Holds mapping of content flagging events to notification targets, with methods to set defaults and validate configuration.

classes.name: TeamReviewerSetting
classes.description: Represents reviewer settings for a team, including enabled status and reviewer IDs.

classes.name: ReviewerSettings
classes.description: Contains reviewer configuration flags for common reviewers, system admins, and team admins, with a method to set default values.

classes.name: AdditionalContentFlaggingSettings
classes.description: Holds additional settings for content flagging, such as reasons, comment requirements, and visibility options, with methods to set defaults and validate.

classes.name: ContentFlaggingSettingsBase
classes.description: Base configuration for content flagging, including enable flag, notification settings, and additional settings, with methods to set defaults and validate.

classes.name: ContentFlaggingSettings
classes.description: Main content flagging configuration extending the base, including reviewer settings, with methods to set defaults and validate.

classes.name: ContentFlaggingReportingConfig
classes.description: Configuration for reporting, including reasons and notification preferences.

classes.name: ReviewerIDsSettings
classes.description: Holds reviewer IDs for common reviewers and team-specific reviewers, with a method to set defaults.

methods.name: SetDefaults
methods.description: Sets default values for various configuration structs.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates configuration structs, returning an error if invalid.
